question: Which of these is a component of the tertiary sector of an economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hotels and restaurants.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __ Key Points__

__
 
• **Hotels and restaurants** are a component of the** tertiary sector **of an economy.
 
• The tertiary sector is also known as the **service sector, **and it includes all activities that provide services to** consumers **and other businesses.
 
• In the** three-sector model**, the third economic sector is the** tertiary sector.**
 
• The** primary** and** secondary** sectors are the others. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mining and quarrying** is a component of the **primary sector** of an economy, which includes all activities related to natural resources extraction.
 
• **Water supply** is a component of the **utility sector** of an economy, which includes all activities related to the provision of public utilities such as water, electricity, and gas.
 
• **Electricity** is also a component of the **utility sector** of an economy, as it is a public utility that is essential for many other economic activities.
 
• All operations with the ultimate goal of using up natural resources—**agricultural, fishing, forestry, mining, and deposits**—are included in the **primary sector.**
 
• The portion of the economy centered on manufacturing is known as the** secondary sector.**
 
 
• **Construction, fabrication, assembly, distillation, and purification** are examples of secondary sector activities.
